utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to hear. I can help spread the word—what kind of repairs are folks still looking at?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still a bit behind on the details, but I think they’re gathering basic repair supplies and volunteers for the usual fixes. I’ll check on the exact list and timing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great. Just let me know when you have the details, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can spread the word and invite a few neighbors to bring tools or spare parts. I’ll reach out today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — that helps a lot. I’m still pinning down the exact spot for the drop-off supplies and repair kits, so once I’ve got it, I’ll point everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — just let me know the drop-off spot when you’ve got it, and I’ll make sure neighbors know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring boxes and a sign-up sheet, and I’ll see if I can round up a few volunteers to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that sounds great. I’m still a little scattered, but I’ll be around to help sort when you drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — I’ll drop them off soon and we’ll sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. Just send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll do my best to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’m sorting the list now and I’ll send it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for it and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — your toolkit, screwdrivers, duct tape, zip ties, and gloves are a good start. Check your storage this afternoon and send me the full list, and I’ll figure out what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’m in for the repair drive. I’ll help track what we still need once Rosa sends the full list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve been telling everyone about it—if you want, I can send you the details and get you added right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Quinn—send me the details and I’ll pass them along while I’m out. I’ll see if I can round up a few more folks to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details and add you in right away. Even a little help would be great!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Let me know if you need help sorting or collecting anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo. If you can send me the updated list, I’ll check what I have and bring only what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the updated list over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still checking on where the drop-off supplies and repair kits are being kept, but I can point you the right way as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’ll wait for the exact location and the list before I decide anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing—I’m checking now, and I’ll send you the exact location plus the list as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a good start—I’ll make sure those supplies are first on the list and I’ll line up a few volunteers too. Do you want me to focus on any specific repair items next?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If you can, let’s prioritize the leaky roof and any broken windows first. I’ll stop by later today and see what else needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ll put leaky roofs and broken windows at the top of the repair list. Thanks, Rey; I’ll have things organized for your stop-by later today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check the latest list and let you know what they’re still short on. Then you can bring exactly what they need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That’d help a lot—I can bring whatever they’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’re welcome — I’ll check what they still need and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can spread the word. Do you have the list of repairs yet, or should I ask around for what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the full repair list yet, so asking around would help. Please gather what’s still needed, and I’ll keep it organized here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll ask around and pull together what’s still needed. I’ll bring you whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that. I’ll sort through the donated items and mark what still works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — that’s a big help. Let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep it moving and let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Kira — I’ll send you the details and get you added right away. If you can, please spread the word to a few neighbors about bringing tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — just confirming, I’m definitely added for the repair drive, right? I can spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, you’re definitely added — I’ll send the details right now. And thanks, I really appreciate you spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, but I’m still passing the word along and keeping folks posted. I’ll let you know once the list is sorted out and we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—thanks, Vik. I’ll keep checking in later to see what tools or supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Gus—those will cover the basics. If you can ask around for a couple volunteers, I’ll keep the list tight and ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can stop by later today and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be a big help, Rey. Stop by later and I’ll show you the list so we can see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll wait for the exact time and the item list before I decide.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — send me the exact time and list, and I’ll check it against school pickup. Once I have that, I can help keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for the exact time and item list, then I can decide.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to hear. What kind of help do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can still help sort the donated items and mark what works — just keep me on the quick jobs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell folks you’re best on the quick jobs and sorting donated items. Anything else I should pass along about what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still tracking down the drop-off supplies and repair kits, but I can point folks the right way as soon as I confirm where they’re kept.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — I’m a bit late to the details too, so I appreciate the update. If you find the exact spot for the supplies and kits, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check on it and let you know as soon as I’ve got the exact spot for the supplies and kits.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the broken lamp and loose fence board. I can help check who’s available, if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. If you can check the list too, I’d rather bring what they’re short on than guess.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll check the list and see who’s available. Then we can bring whatever they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking where the drop-off supplies and repair kits are, so I can point folks to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — if you can point people to the kits, I’ll bring the tools and we can tackle the lamp and fence board.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’m still checking where the kits are kept, and I’ll send people your way as soon as I know. Thanks for bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. Please send me the details—I may be able to help a little.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’ll send the details right over. Thanks, Uli, even a little help would be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll look for them and see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check the latest list and tell you what they’re still short on. Then you can bring exactly what they need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—just send me the short list, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll grab the latest short list and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: First I need to know what tools and supplies you’ve already got, so I can see what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got a small toolbox, a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails—maybe a tape measure too. Tell me what else I should look for.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the hammer and screwdriver ready for the repair drive. Where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — you can drop them off at my porch anytime today. I’ll make sure they get to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll swing by your porch later today and leave them there. Thanks, Mara.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
